scope: Disk-backed canonical Memory service listing with a 10 ms host Stop timer, authority locking, index validation and selected shard validation.
limitations: Local fixed hardware measurement, not cross-platform admission or a native IDE Stop journey.
Timers measure event-loop delivery and acknowledgement separately; OS caches are not flushed.
A query that completes before the Stop deadline requires no cancellation; late successful completion is reported as a failure of responsiveness.
